Ledger

BillItem is the line. ItemShare is your piece.

Trezzit stores a bill as a set of line items, then stores one share row per participant for each item. That is the atomic unit behind splitting, personal expense categorization, balances, imports, audit trails, and AI queries.

The model in one table.

ledger.item_shares BillItem -> ItemShare
bill_id item_name item_price share_person share_amount category_status

Fields

The field names are the product behavior.

The marketing claim is concrete because these fields exist in the backend model and write path. Item shares are not a derived reporting trick; they are the rows the bill creation flow writes.

Bill

The parent receipt or expense record: group, payer, date, currency, total, and version.

BillItem.name

The receipt line: pizza, tiramisu, wine bottle, service fee.

BillItem.price

The item amount that shares must reconcile against within one cent.

ItemShare.person

The person attached to this portion of the item.

ItemShare.share_amount

The amount that person owes for that item.

ItemShare.split_type

Equal, percentage, exact, shares, or adjusted, stored per share.

ItemShare.category

The category attached to this person share, not just the whole bill.

ItemShare.tags

User-defined tags layered onto the shared bill record.

Invariant

The math has guardrails.

Every bill has at least one item. Every item is split into person-level rows. Item shares must sum to the item price within one cent, and the bill total must equal the sum of item prices.

Splits

Mixed split methods are normal.

A single receipt can have shared groceries, one person's dessert, a weighted service fee, and an exact bottle split. The split type is stored where it belongs: on the share attached to the item.

Audit

Versioned bills, attributed writes.

Bill edits bump the bill version and write audit rows. MCP-created bills are attributed to the AI agent that created them, so the ledger can distinguish app actions from agent actions.

T Trezzit

An itemized ledger for shared expenses. Split receipts, preserve item shares, and let AI answer from the same rows the app uses.
